takes.sourceDescription: football - throw, catch (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Mime a Football Exchange from Standing, Participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B alternates short steps with bringing the forearms forward and drawing the hands close. The sequence returns to standing with arms lowered.

takes.sourceDescription: football - throw, catch, jump around (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Reach Up and Step Through a Football Exchange, Participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B opens with one hand high, reaches overhead with both hands, then turns through short steps and forward arm motions. The take ends with the elbows bent.
